name: Volvo Settings Shell
summary: Volvo settings now expose card-based navigation to both the part catalog and a persisted To/CC recipient editor used by the Volvo email preview dialog.

userActions: Review, add, edit, deactivate, and import Volvo part master-data rows
Open Volvo settings into the part catalog or recipient editor
Add, edit, and delete Volvo To and CC recipients
Review selected part details and related component records
preserveRules: Keep Volvo recipients stored separately from Reporting recipients
Keep the settings entry path aligned with the card navigation behavior
Keep recipients presented as cards rather than a grid
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting Volvo settings opens a card-based shell for part catalog and recipient maintenance
Users can maintain Volvo To and CC recipients from the settings surface
Metadata reflects the live Volvo settings files and user-visible workflow
validationHints: Confirm the part catalog page loads the Volvo part list and still launches add, edit, deactivate, and component-review actions
Confirm the Volvo settings shell opens both the Part Catalog and Email Recipients cards
Confirm recipient cards can be added, edited, and deleted without using a data table
Confirm saved Volvo recipients appear in the Volvo email preview dialog
sensitiveDataRules: Do not expose raw connection strings in UI change requests or mockups
Keep secret-bearing fields masked or routed to deployment-time secret storage
